final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_byte_rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_byte_rate) AS cross_media_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(avg_byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(avg_byte_rate - cross_media_rate) AS avg_rate_excess FROM media_rates CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE avg_byte_rate > cross_media_rate
